bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea at The Roseate Edinburgh, a five-star boutique hotel, situated within two Victorian townhouses close to Edinburgh city centre.  Served in The Dunstane Restaurant & Bar and The Roseate Garden, Afternoon Tea at The Roseate Edinburgh is a delicious spread of freshly prepared sandwiches, home bakes cakes and fluffy scones slathered with locally made jam and Scottish cream. Enjoy it with a selection of fine teas, a glass of Champagne or an artisan gin selection and make it a Hendricks G&Tea.  The Roseate Edinburgh are delighted to bring you a choice of teas selected by the Tea Lovers’ Company. Founded in St Andrews in 2012, the company produces fine whole-leaf teas in eco-friendly pyramid bags.  During the summer months, Afternoon Tea can be enjoyed in the Roseate Garden, nestled on the steps and lawn of The Roseate Edinburgh.  Afternoon Tea is served daily from 12pm to 5pm and costs £30 per person or £42 with a glass of Joseph Perrier Champagne.
